spec_triplet_integrity.pass: >= 90% complete triplets or only known legacy debt prevents full pass

layer_coverage.pass: L0-L6 all have at least partial spec coverage or documented low-confidence reason
layer_coverage.fail: any layer missing from registry/world model

language_coverage.pass: all first-party languages have at least one spec or architecture reference

capability_coverage.pass: all 12 native capabilities have path-backed presence and at least one spec/report/test reference

test_linkage.pass: core L2 capabilities have test linkage
